notes.title: Update 0.2!

notes.title: Experimental Update 1
notes.notes: [p]Hi! I've decided to push out the first experimental update on the [b]Experimental Branch[/b].[/p][p]If you would like to try it out, you can do so in the [b]Betas[/b] tab of the properties page of Cargo.[/p][p][/p][h2]This update is now available on the default branch[/h2][p][/p][h2]VERY IMPORTANT[/h2][p]TO PLAY THIS UPDATE, YOU MUST DELETE YOUR SAVE FILE. THIS CAN BE FOUND IN C:\\Users\\<your name>\\Documents\\Cargo\\Saves. notes.title: CARGO IS RELEASE
notes.notes:
I kinda overestimated how much time it would take to get Cargo release ready. BUT IT'S OUT NOW ON EARLY ACCESS. I honestly don't even know what to say with this. This has been my dream game to create, even though it's not fully finished. It is finished enough though that I think everyone would enjoy playing it. I plan to release multiplayer and several other features in the coming months, especially during the summer when I'm not busy with school. 

You can track my progress with the game on Trello [url=https://trello.com/b/amJObfki/cargo]here.[/url]

If you want to suggest features or report bugs, join the Discord [url=https://discord.gg/xEVmT4S5Q4]here.[/url]

Happy Gaming!!!

notes.title: CARGO HAS BEEN APPROVED FOR RELEASE
notes.notes: It's official! Cargo has been approved for release by Steam and should be available for purchase sometime this week! I have poured so much time into this project and can't wait to get it out there for everyone to play. Just have fun! :3

notes.title: Our Progress (and when the next update is released)
notes.notes:
I'd like to take a minute to talk about our progress in the game and make some announcements.

[h1]The Future of Killswitch Games[/h1]
As you may know from my last post for the 2.0A update, I am a solo developer for Killswitch (my company). Not anymore, [b][i]technically[/i][/b]. I have started working with one of my closest IRL friends on map design and the [b]story[/b] for Cargo. She is working under Killswitch Games but she is not working for me. I'd also like to announce that Killswitch Games is currently in the process of being renamed to Floppy Fish Studios. I'd like to focus on creating silly goofy fun games for everyone to play. And I think that the name Killswitch is too... Violent? Especially for the type of games I work on.

[h1]When should you expect Cargo to be released?[/h1]
I plan to release Cargo sometime during the summer this year at the earliest, this could extend into fall but it is unlikely. After the release, we will definitely keep making updates. This is my first ever game, so I plan to put everything into it. 

[h1]Our Next Project[/h1]
For our next project, [b]Silly Cat Game[/b]. Which is pretty self explanatory. I have worked on it a little bit during my downtime working on Cargo. But i'm not going to fully commit to it till after I fully publish Cargo. Also, SCG will be created in Godot which should help with lag and such stuff. I will have to figure out how to integrate it onto Steam but once I work on it and get a first release for it, it will be on itch.io for free.

[h1]Contact & Recommendations[/h1]
If you have any questions about Cargo and want to recommend some features or game ideas to us, shoot me a message on Discord (scythepng) or [url=https://discord.gg/tRFfMsPqEg]join our Discord[/url].

I love making this game and I hope I can release it soon. I want you guys to have fun while playing this.
